## Author checklist

- [ ] File named `proposals/CR-DIDAS-NNNN-short-title.md` with the next free number
- [ ] All template sections filled in (use "n/a" where not applicable)
- [ ] Every claim verified against the current swiyu spec in swiyu-admin-ch
- [ ] Every claim referenced with a commit-pinned permalink
- [ ] *Sources* table filled in (version, status, commit, date checked)
- [ ] Spec/implementation discrepancies noted
- [ ] Ecosystem impact described
- [ ] Front matter filled in (status, sectors, steward, updated)
- [ ] Use cases, trust flows and glossary terms linked as evidence
- [ ] Row added to `proposals/README.md`
- [ ] Changelog entry added in `changelog/`
- [ ] Terms consistent with the DIDAS glossary
- [ ] Relevant interests disclosed

## Governance gates (steward / maintainers)

Do not merge until all are ticked. See GOVERNANCE.md.

- [ ] Steward assigned and agrees the proposal is ready for consultation
- [ ] Affected sectors confirmed; their working group(s) named in the *Governance* table and notified
- [ ] Consultation period of at least 14 days completed
- [ ] Every consulted working group has stated a position
- [ ] *Community input* summary written, including dissenting views
- [ ] *Sources* re-verified against the latest swiyu spec before the council decision
- [ ] Council decision(s) of the affected sectors recorded as **endorsed** (date and link)
- [ ] Cross-sector: positions consolidated by DIDAS as orchestrator; escalation to the Steering Circle recorded if any
- [ ] Status set to *Endorsed* in the proposal and the index
